message.content: {"answer": "B", "option_text": "In Figure 1, the bilateral interstitial infiltrations are centrally located, while the nodules in Figures 2a and 2b are centrally and subpleurally distributed, with most nodules vanishing in Figure 3 post-chemotherapy.", "reason": "Visual inspection of Figure 1 (CXR) shows perihilar/central interstitial opacities. Figures 2a and 2b (CT) demonstrate multiple nodules with both central (peribronchovascular) and subpleural distribution. Figure 3 (CT) shows near-complete resolution of these nodules, consistent with a positive response to chemotherapy. Options A, C, D, E, and F incorrectly describe the distribution or the outcome (unchanged/increased)."}
